units.source_text: 门外朝雾弥漫，天空景色幽奇，遍地浓霜，一白无际。

en.t: Outside the gate, morning mist spread everywhere; the sky looked strangely beautiful, and thick frost covered the ground in an endless sheet of white.

units.source_text: 源氏公子对景寻思：此刻倘是真的幽会归来，这才够味。

en.t: Looking at the scene, Prince Genji thought to himself: if he were truly returning now from a secret tryst, this would be just the right mood.
But as things were, he still felt that something was missing from the beauty of it all.

units.source_text: 他想起了一个极秘密的情妇，她家就在这归途上。

en.t: He remembered a lover of his who was kept in the deepest secrecy, and her house lay right along this road home.

units.source_text: 便在那里停车，叫人去敲门。

en.t: So he stopped the carriage there and sent someone to knock at the gate.
But no one inside heard it.

units.source_text: 计无所出，便叫一个嗓子好些儿的随从在门外唱起诗歌来：

en.t: With no other plan, he had one of his attendants with a better voice begin singing a poem outside the gate:
